lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct vertical lines traversing the torso; spacing is relatively uniform across the ribcage, exhibiting slight compression toward the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most vertical lines (10th and 11th) are composed of fragmented, dashed segments that do not extend to the lower ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6-8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the upper mid-thigh align in a semi-linear diagonal orientation.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct white horizontal band on the upper foreleg (antebrachium) and white spots on the cheek, though face is partially obscured by branches.
